zh: 补齐开衫三段用线的另接线、断线、暂停、恢复和藏线步骤，并检查当前工作环、线端状态与跨分段正反面连续性。
指定袖口接合版列出三次断线及六个线端的藏线；打开袖口版明确暂停工作环，保留后续接合用线。收尾动作不改变织物针位计数。
本构造统一正面分袖与挑袖，肩深按可用奇数行量化并显示估算值；旧工序标记为未跟踪用线。
生成下载缓存同时绑定输入和引擎版本；用线收尾记录仅表示图解已列出步骤，仍不证明实钩、边缘或合身通过。
en: Add explicit yarn starts, fasten-offs, parked/resumed loops and individual end-weaving instructions with active-loop and cross-section side checks.
Selected cuff seams include three fasten-offs and six end-weaving instructions; open cuffs preserve marked loops and their yarn supply. Finishing does not consume fabric sites.
Use RS split/pickup for this method, quantize depth to supported odd rows, and mark legacy paths as yarn-untracked.
Bind downloads to both inputs and engine version. Instruction accounting does not establish physical execution, edge quality or fit.
